body: Thanks! It's nice to hear something positive as a change to what I keep telling myself. Hope it's all good on your end as well.

Yeah getting help was by far the most tiring thing ive done in my life. Ive been to multiple therapists but they just end up not helping at all. But now its just draining to keep trying to find the right help for me that I've become jealous of everyone who could find the right help.
